observations.population: Owen Paterson MP case; one committee recommendation
observations.denominator: 30 sitting days recommended; not imposed by House
observations.note: Committee finding is not criminal conviction; House did not approve the suspension.

observations.measure: House-approved suspension after Standards Committee finding and dismissed appeal
observations.denominator: One approved suspension, five sitting days; not a population rate
observations.note: Distinguish approved House sanction from committee recommendation and from completed time served.

observations.measure: House-approved suspension after Standards Committee finding and dismissed appeal
observations.denominator: One approved suspension, 30 days; do not equate with 30 sitting days
observations.note: Subsequent recall is separately recorded in official report; this is not a criminal-conviction indicator.

observations.measure: Average processing time for SSA initial disability claims
observations.population: SSA initial disability claims processed during FY2022
observations.denominator: Average days per completed initial claim; not time for appeals
observations.note: GAO 2025 high-risk review; same metric FY2024=231 days.

observations.measure: Average processing time for SSA initial disability claims
observations.population: SSA initial disability claims processed during FY2024
observations.denominator: Average days per completed initial claim; not time for appeals
observations.note: GAO reports about 26% increase from FY2022; do not infer a causal explanation.

observations.measure: Pending SSA initial disability claims at fiscal year end
observations.denominator: Inventory snapshot; not claims processed or unique applicants
observations.note: GAO says about 941,000; not an exact administrative count.

observations.measure: Pending SSA initial disability claims at fiscal year end
observations.denominator: Inventory snapshot; not claims processed or unique applicants
observations.note: GAO says about 1.2 million; rounded, not exact.

observations.measure: Pending SSA disability appeals at fiscal year end
observations.denominator: Appeals inventory; distinct from initial claims inventory

observations.measure: Pending SSA disability appeals at fiscal year end
observations.denominator: Appeals inventory; distinct from initial claims inventory
observations.note: GAO says about 262,000; counterexample to uniform deterioration.

observations.population: VA initial disability compensation claims in agency backlog
observations.denominator: Backlog stock, not all filed claims or processed cases
observations.note: GAO says about 244,000, down from over 600,000 in March 2013; no exact prior baseline transcribed.

observations.measure: Average processing time of completed PACT Act disability claims
observations.population: VA PACT Act claims completed in reported month
observations.denominator: Mean days per completed PACT Act claim; not all VA claims
observations.note: GAO says about 155 days in August 2023.

observations.measure: Average processing time of completed PACT Act disability claims
observations.population: VA PACT Act claims completed in reported month
observations.denominator: Mean days per completed PACT Act claim; not all VA claims
observations.note: GAO says about 168 days in November 2024.

observations.measure: Completed PACT Act claims within VA 125-day goal
observations.population: VA completed PACT Act claims in reported month
observations.denominator: Percent of completed PACT Act claims; denominator count not reported in GAO passage
observations.note: September 2023 percentage; different month from August 2023 processing-time mean.

observations.measure: Completed PACT Act claims within VA 125-day goal
observations.population: VA completed PACT Act claims in reported month
observations.denominator: Percent of completed PACT Act claims; denominator count not reported in GAO passage
observations.note: November 2024 percentage; not the share of all filed claims.

observations.measure: Average processing time of completed non-PACT Act claims
observations.population: VA non-PACT Act claims completed in November 2024
observations.denominator: Mean days per completed non-PACT claim; distinct from PACT subset
observations.note: GAO says 129 days; compare against PACT with case-mix caveats.

observations.measure: Completed non-PACT Act claims within 125-day goal
observations.population: VA non-PACT Act claims completed in November 2024
observations.denominator: Percent of completed non-PACT claims; absolute count not reported in GAO passage
observations.note: Not the same denominator as 37% PACT Act claims.

observations.measure: Average processing time of all completed initial VA disability claims
observations.population: VA initial disability claims completed in November 2024
observations.denominator: All initial disability claims, not just PACT or non-PACT subgroup
observations.note: GAO says about 139 days; do not average PACT and non-PACT means without weights.

observations.measure: Average decision time for VA Board of Veterans Appeals hearing-option cases
observations.population: VA modernized appeals process, hearing option
observations.denominator: Mean days for hearing-option appeals, not all appeals or initial claims
observations.note: GAO 2025 reports 1,089 days as of June 2024.

observations.measure: VA Board hearing-option appeal decision-time goal
observations.population: VA modernized appeals process, hearing option
observations.denominator: Agency goal, not achieved mean; compare with 1,089-day observation
observations.note: Do not count a performance target as an observed service result.

events.subject: Owen Paterson MP
events.finding: Parliamentary Commissioner notified Paterson of inquiry into alleged paid advocacy.
events.disposition: Inquiry opening is an allegation stage, not a finding.

events.subject: Owen Paterson MP
events.finding: Standards Committee found serious paid-advocacy breaches and recommended 30 sitting days suspension.
events.disposition: Recommendation required House action; no criminal conviction or imposed suspension.

events.subject: House of Commons
events.finding: House amended motion, declining to consider committee report and proposing a new committee.
events.disposition: No House vote approving the 30-day suspension on this date.

events.subject: Owen Paterson MP
events.finding: Paterson announced resignation as MP; retrospective 2024 parliamentary report confirms House did not impose recommended suspension.
events.disposition: Resignation is a separate consequence, not a 30-day suspension served.

events.subject: Andrew Bridgen MP
events.finding: Committee found rule breaches and recommended five sitting days suspension.
events.disposition: Committee recommendation, not yet House-approved sanction.

events.subject: Andrew Bridgen MP
events.finding: House agreed five sitting days suspension after appeal was dismissed.
events.disposition: Approval is documented; no inference about unrelated criminal liability.

events.subject: Margaret Ferrier MP
events.finding: Committee found rule breaches and recommended 30 days suspension.
events.disposition: Not equivalent to a criminal verdict; report date differs from House sanction date.

events.subject: Margaret Ferrier MP
events.finding: House agreed 30 days suspension after appeal dismissed; parliamentary report also records subsequent recall.
events.disposition: Sanction approved, unlike Paterson; recall is separate outcome.

events.subject: House of Commons Committee on Standards
events.finding: Report tabulates committee recommendations and consequential outcomes across multiple cases.
events.disposition: Retrospective reference is not new misconduct finding or evidence of comparative guilt.

events.subject: US Government Accountability Office
events.finding: GAO published high-risk review containing VA and SSA administrative service-performance records.
events.disposition: Audit synthesis is not a finding of individual misconduct and not a survey of trust.

methodology.unitOfAnalysis: Individual parliamentary cases and recommended/approved sanction durations are distinct from agency claims, appeal inventories, completed-claim means, and percentages.
methodology.statusGuardrail: Allegation, committee finding, recommendation, House-approved sanction, resignation, independent audit, agency performance target and survey perception are distinct.
methodology.denominatorGuardrail: No absolute denominators for several VA percentages in GAO summary; completed PACT/non-PACT cases, pending claims, appeals and unique persons are not interchangeable.
methodology.timeGuardrail: GAO 2025 publication reports agency periods in 2022–2024; UK 2024 retrospective summarizes events in 2019–2023. Never treat publication date as event date.
methodology.modelGuardrail: No causal or cross-country trend inference; selected cases are illustrative and not an exhaustive sanctions denominator.
methodology.productionGuardrail: Do not merge into redistricting data/app-feed.json or production frontend without licensing, compatibility and design validation.
